title: hybrid-staged-canary-controller-with-statistical-gates-and-fallthrough-routing
author: Marisol Vega
description: Motivation: enable safer multi-stage experiments and automated rollback by introducing a hybrid staged canary controller that combines time/traffic phasing, Bayesian statistical gates, and deterministic fallthrough routing. This PR implements a controller that can run A/B tests, shadow trials, and progressive canaries using a configurable stability window, significance threshold, and quarantine queue. Key features: 1) BayesianSignificanceEngine (configurable priors) to decide pass/fail for metric families; 2) HealthSnapshot store that captures per-route histograms and model KV cache hit rates at sample intervals; 3) WeightDecaySchedule to gradually reduce canary traffic on persistent regressions before triggering full rollback; 4) FallthroughRouting that routes traffic to a fallback model variant instantly on hard failures while preserving request affinity; 5) QuarantineQueue and automated re-evaluation that isolates problematic model variants and automatically schedules a re-test after a cool-down with adjusted batch/quant settings; 6) DriftDetector to abort experiments when input distribution divergence exceeds threshold; 7) Integration hooks for Redwood Optimize to emit suggested quantization/batching profiles for canaries. Checklist: - [x] controller implementation and reconciliation loop - [x] Bayesian engine + unit tests - [x] health snapshot persistence and API - [x] fallthrough routing and affinity preservation - [x] quarantine queue and automated re-test job - [x] shadow traffic passthrough mode - [x] docs and runbook updates - [x] e2e smoke test in perf-canary harness How to test locally: run ./hack/dev-canary with two local model variants, set linear key ENG-9123 as test target, verify that induced regression (synthetic label noise) triggers weight decay then quarantine and eventual rollback. Backward compatibility: defaults preserve previous canary semantics if hybrid_mode=false. Migration: adds CRD fields canary.strategy and canary.statsEngine but controller tolerates absent fields. Related: ENG-9123 for rollout design, ENG-9188 for metric extraction, SUP-447 incident notes. Impact: improves safety and reduces noisy manual rollbacks; expected to reduce manual interventions by ~40% for staged rollouts (internal estimate).

release_notes: Adds a hybrid staged canary controller with Bayesian statistical gates, fallthrough routing, quarantine/re-test automation, and integration points for Optimize suggestions. Provides safer automated rollbacks and input-drift based aborts; defaults maintain backward compatibility.
security_implications: No new broad network surface exposed; controller CRDs respect RBAC and only rollout-admin role may toggle auto-quarantine. Added audit events for quarantine and rollback actions.
perf_impact: Introduces lightweight snapshotting (~5-10ms per sample) and an optional drift detector (configurable sampling rate). Expected negligible p95 impact when run at recommended sample rates.
